name: ShowHistoryOnChart-V1.1
summary: This EA reads trade history from a CSV file and visually displays it on the chart using colored arrows for buy/sell open and close points, connected by dotted trendlines. It does not execute any trades itself; it is purely a visualization tool for reviewing past trading activity.
summary_zh: 该EA从CSV文件中读取交易历史记录，并在图表上用彩色箭头标示买入/卖出的开仓和平仓点位，以虚线趋势线连接。它本身不执行任何交易，纯粹是一个用于回顾过去交易活动的可视化工具。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略程序，而是一个交易历史可视化工具。它在OnInit()初始化阶段从MQL5/Files目录下读取用户指定的CSV文件，解析每笔交易的开仓时间、方向、手数、品种、开仓价、平仓时间、平仓价、佣金、掉期和利润等字段。对于买入交易，使用蓝色箭头和趋势线标记；对于卖出交易，使用红色箭头和趋势线标记。开仓点用买入/卖出箭头对象标示，平仓点用反向箭头标示，两者之间用虚线趋势线连接，直观展示每笔交易的入场和出场轨迹。仓位管理和资金管理方面完全不涉及，因为该工具不进行任何交易操作。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy program but a trade history visualization tool. During OnInit(), it reads a user-specified CSV file from the MQL5/Files directory, parsing each trade's open time, direction, volume, symbol, open price, close time, close price, commission, swap, and profit fields. Buy trades are marked with blue arrows and trendlines; sell trades are marked with red arrows and trendlines. The open point is indicated with a buy/sell arrow object, the close point with the opposite arrow, and a dotted trendline connects both to visually display each trade's entry and exit trajectory. Position sizing and money management are entirely absent since this tool does not perform any trading operations.

parameters.name: fileName
parameters.description: CSV文件名（需放置在MQL5/Files目录下，以分号为分隔符）

pros: 直观可视化交易历史，便于复盘分析交易表现
用颜色区分多空方向，箭头和趋势线组合展示入场出场，信息清晰
实现简单轻量，不占用运行时资源（仅在初始化时执行一次）
pros_en: Intuitive visualization of trade history, making it easy to review and analyze trading performance
Color-coded buy/sell directions with arrow and trendline combination clearly shows entry and exit points
Simple and lightweight implementation, consuming no runtime resources (executes only once during initialization)
cons: 全局变量clr、objectArrowOpen等未在函数内声明，多实例或重复初始化时存在状态冲突风险
CSV解析脆弱：StringSubstr截取价格硬编码为7字符，对不同价格精度品种会导致价格错误
FileReadString(handle,4)读取4个字段跳过列的方式不可靠，如果CSV格式略有变化就会解析错位
无错误处理：文件不存在或格式错误时无用户提示，仅静默失败
OnDeinit删除所有对象过于激进，会清除图表上其他EA或手动添加的对象
cons_en: Global variables clr, objectArrowOpen etc. are declared outside functions, risking state conflicts with multiple instances or re-initialization
Fragile CSV parsing: StringSubstr hardcodes price truncation to 7 characters, causing errors for symbols with different price precision
FileReadString(handle,4) to skip 4 columns is unreliable; any slight CSV format change causes parsing misalignment
No error handling: when the file doesn't exist or has format errors, there is no user notification — it silently fails
OnDeinit's ObjectsDeleteAll is overly aggressive, removing all chart objects including those from other EAs or manual additions
improvements: 将全局变量改为函数内局部变量，并在对象命名中加入品种前缀以避免冲突
使用完整的字符串转Double方式替代StringSubstr硬编码截取，并增加CSV文件格式校验和错误提示
OnDeinit中仅删除本EA创建的对象，使用统一前缀标记而非删除全部对象
improvements_en: Move global variables to local scope within OnInit, and add symbol prefix to object names to avoid naming conflicts
Replace StringSubstr hard-coded truncation with proper string-to-double conversion, and add CSV format validation with error prompts
In OnDeinit, only delete objects created by this EA using a unified naming prefix instead of deleting all chart objects

risk_points: ObjectsDeleteAll会清除图表上所有对象，包括其他指标或手动添加的绘图，造成意外数据丢失
全局变量状态在重复初始化时可能产生竞态条件，但在非交易工具中影响有限
risk_points_en: ObjectsDeleteAll removes all chart objects including those from other indicators or manual drawings, causing accidental data loss
Global variable state may cause race conditions on re-initialization, though impact is limited for a non-trading utility
